images.note: Real Snowsight screenshot from Snowflake's own official 'Getting Started with Snowflake' Quickstart guide, showing a real worksheet: the SQL editor, the database object tree (Databases/Worksheets tabs), the role switcher, and the warehouse selector.

imageNote: Snowflake's reference docs (docs.snowflake.com) render almost no UI screenshots at all — checked several pages via a Browser img.src scan and found none beyond cookie-banner logos. The real screenshots for this course come from Snowflake's own Quickstarts site (quickstarts.snowflake.com), which is NOT JS-rendered — a plain curl of the guide's HTML directly reveals every real image URL (hosted at snowflake.com/content/dam/snowflake-site/...), no browser tool needed. This is the opposite gotcha from GitHub/Microsoft docs this catalog has hit before — worth remembering for the rest of this course.
